+ acc. Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'спитать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to raise, bring up, educate', paired with 'воспитывать'.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'everything', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.
